Camping

The Alcatraz campsite is open from Thursday 5/8 (9h) till Monday 9/8 (noon)

24/7 free access to clean, well-maintained sanitary facilities (showers and toilets with running water).

Alcatraz Graveyard

The campsite is open from Thursday 5 August at 9 a.m.

Remember to purchase your camping tickets (€25,5/pp, compulsory for every camper) in advance.

Motorhomes

At the Motorhome Campsite each motorhome is allocated a pitch. 1 electric hook-up (220V/16A) is provided per motorhome/caravan. (camping ticket compulsory for every camper)
